⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Audio sample rate in Hertz.

Typical values: `8000`, `16000`, `24000`, `44100`, `48000`.

For Opus, this is the decoder's reported output rate; libopus will
internally resample to this value.
